description: Land Acquisition - Compensations for the Allotments of Lands in Mattakkuliya, Colombo D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette notice deals exclusively with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed information about specific land parcels being acquired by the state, including location details (village, district, province), plot numbers, land extents, and statutory compensation amounts. The content focuses solely on land property matters without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
